items.reason: Same agent. No INN is given in the record; the manual says not to invent one and to use the name as first written ('Recombinant Human Endostatin'). The moiety mapping script will normalise either form.

Every arm receives the same triplet; by C3 a drug every arm receives is soc_backbone even if it is not GBM standard of care, with the investigational question deciding the candidate. The official title frames it as 'Recombinant Human Endostatin Combined with Cytotoxic Chemotherapy Regimen' and the summary cites prior TMZ +/- irinotecan results as the baseline, so irinotecan is background. Caveat: the summary also aims 'to confirm the efficacy and safety of the combination of rh-ES, temozolomide and irinotecan'.
